root_cause_label: Missing named group ACL entry for research group
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent set only the owning group ACL entry (group::rwx) instead of an explicit named group entry (group:research:rwx) for both access and default ACLs, then claimed completion without detecting the discrepancy in the getfacl output.
t_err_evidence: omits explicit ACL entries for the named group 'research' in both current and default ACLs
t_commit_evidence: setfacl -d -m u:alice:rwx,u:bob:rwx,g::rwx,o::---,m::rwx /srv/shared — default ACL also missing named group:research entry
t_surface_evidence: ACL output lacks the explicit 'group:research' entries; shows only group::rwx and default:group::rwx
trigger_explanation: The agent lacked precise knowledge that the task required an explicit named group ACL entry (g:research:rwx) distinct from the owning group ACL entry (g::rwx), treating the owning group entry as sufficient.
